# LINFAIR

> LINFAIR (Dongguan Lingfei Textile Co., Ltd.) is a professional women's knitwear manufacturer based in Dongguan, China, specializing in premium cashmere blends, fleece-lined sweaters, cardigans and knit tops. We offer OEM/ODM services for global fashion brands with full in-house production: yarn sourcing, knitting, quality control and worldwide shipping.

## About

- [About LINFAIR](https://linfairwool.cn/about): Company background, factory capabilities and why brands choose us
- [Contact](https://linfairwool.cn/contact): Request a quote or get in touch for OEM/ODM inquiries
